user.title: Home Organizer Setup
user.description: Choose how Home Organizer should process AI requests.

data_description.processing_mode: Hybrid uses your local AI for text and a cloud model for images.
data_description.ai_provider: Only used in Cloud or Hybrid mode. Gemini has a generous free tier.
data_description.use_stylist: Requires additional setup on the next screen.

api_keys.title: API Keys and Models
api_keys.description: Credentials are stored in your Home Assistant configuration and are never written to the log.

data_description.custom_cloud_url: Optional. Typically only used for enterprise proxies.
data_description.local_api_url: Ollama: http://<IP>:11434/v1. LM Studio: http://<IP>:1234/v1. Must end in /v1.
data_description.local_api_key: Local servers usually ignore this, but do not leave it blank. Type 'ollama' or 'local'.
data_description.local_model: Run 'ollama list' and copy the name exactly, for example llama3:8b.

stylist.title: Virtual Try-On
stylist.description: Configure the image generation provider used by the Stylist agent.

data_description.vto_model: Only needed if you use a custom workflow.

triggers.title: Trigger Words and Permissions
triggers.description: Trigger words are translated into your interface language automatically. You can override any of them here in any language.

data.allow_scripts: Allow the assistant to run scripts and scenes
data.delete_on_remove: Delete all data when the integration is removed

data_description.allow_scripts: Off by default. A script can perform any action you wrote into it, including operating a lock, so enable this only if you want the assistant to start your scripts. Locks, covers and alarm panels are never controlled by the assistant directly; those requests are handled by Home Assistant's own voice assistant.
data_description.delete_on_remove: Caution: this permanently wipes the database and all stored images.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of Home Organizer is supported
